overview: November 23rd brought a substantial 13-patch series from Meta's Mykyta Yatsenko introducing inline value embedding for BPF local storage maps, aiming to reduce memory allocation overhead for small-value use cases. Leon Hwang continued work on BPF link_create logging with a 9-patch v3 series extending diagnostic support to tracing, iter, and cgroup program types, while Abhishek Khade posted a v3 of new bpf_memmem kfuncs for memory searching within dynptrs.

patches.title: bpf: Free unpublished local storage with kfree_nolock()
patches.author: Mykyta Yatsenko
patches.summary: This is the first patch in a 13-patch v2 series ('bpf: Embed local storage values in the storage object') from Meta that introduces a new BPF_F_INLINE_VALUE flag for local storage maps. The core idea is to embed the map value directly within the bpf_local_storage object rather than allocating a separate slab object, reducing allocator pressure for maps with small values. The series adds an inline slot allocator to local storage caches, extends the sk diag interface to show inline values, restricts iterators for inline-value maps, and adds full libbpf and documentation support.

patches.title: bpf: Add log support for tracing link_create
patches.author: Leon Hwang
patches.summary: First patch in a 9-patch v3 series extending the BPF verifier log to link_create operations for tracing programs. The series adds log buffer support to the tracing, tracing_multi, iter, and cgroup prog link_create paths, allowing users to retrieve verifier-style diagnostic messages when attaching BPF programs via links. Libbpf gains corresponding log_opts support for BPF_TRACE_ITER, and selftests verify each new log path.

patches.title: bpf: Add bpf_memmem and bpf_dynptr_memmem kfuncs
patches.author: Abhishek Khade
patches.summary: This v3 series adds two new kfuncs to the BPF subsystem: bpf_memmem for searching a byte pattern within a raw memory region, and bpf_dynptr_memmem for the same operation against a dynptr. These kfuncs mirror the semantics of the standard C library memmem() function and allow BPF programs performing packet inspection or data parsing to locate substrings without requiring custom loop logic. Selftests cover both new kfuncs.

patches.title: bpf: Fix kfunc implicit arg inject type detection to prevent invalid pointer deref
patches.author: chenyuan
patches.summary: This v7 fix corrects a bug in the BPF verifier's kfunc implicit argument injection path where incorrect type detection could lead to an invalid pointer dereference. The verifier incorrectly classified the injection target type under certain conditions, potentially causing a kernel crash when attaching programs that use kfuncs with implicit arguments. The companion selftest was strengthened to verify aux injection behavior directly.

patches.title: bpf, arm32: build constants inline instead of using a literal pool
patches.author: Ramin Moussavi
patches.summary: This v3 single-patch series improves the ARM32 BPF JIT by encoding 32-bit immediate constants directly inline using MOV/MOVT instruction pairs rather than loading them from a literal pool. The change eliminates the need for a separate literal pool section in JIT-compiled programs, reducing code size overhead and improving cache locality. This is particularly beneficial for programs with many constant loads.

patches.title: Documentation/bpf: Update sockmap docs for mutation restrictions
patches.author: Ahmad Wicaksono
patches.summary: A two-patch v2 documentation series that updates the BPF sockmap and map documentation. The first patch clarifies mutation restrictions in the sockmap docs, and the second fixes stale file path references in the selftests documentation that had become outdated as the test suite was reorganized. These are housekeeping changes with no code impact.
